response.justification: Bogdan Szabo has extensive experience as a Senior Full Stack Engineer with 9+ years of relevant work history, including roles at re:cinq, Optilyz, and GISCollective. His expertise in TypeScript, Node.js, React, and MongoDB aligns well with the primary stack. He also demonstrates proficiency in other required technologies like AWS, Docker, and testing frameworks. His contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and open-source projects showcase innovation and depth. While his experience with Nest.js is not explicitly mentioned, his adaptability with multiple languages and frameworks suggests quick learning ability.

Proven track record in scalable systems and AI-agent infrastructure
Strong open-source contributions and community engagement
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js (core primary stack requirement)
Primary stack alignment is strong, but secondary stack (Kotlin/Java) usage is not highlighted in recent roles
